title: The Welcome popup and the two tour stages record each scene or step reached and how the showing ended (POST /api/onboarding/step)
steps: S1: POST /api/onboarding/step signed out; then {runId, flow: welcome, step} for steps 1, 2, 2; then end escape, then end close, at step 2; then a tour-site end skip at publish.
S2: POST bodies off the closed lists: no runId, a bad runId, flow checkout, flow toString, welcome step 9, tour-start step publish, welcome end skip, tour-site end cta.
S3: Render the Welcome popup, press ArrowRight twice, then Escape.
S4: First-run tour on a screen with only Create a new site: press Skip. Site tour: press Skip at the first step shown.
S5: Compare the client's SCENES, START_STEPS and SITE_STEPS with ONBOARD_FLOWS in apps/tracy-web/src/onboarding/usage.js.
expect: S1: 401; three 200; onboard.step rows for steps 1 and 2 only; one onboard.exit row, end escape at step 2; a tour-site exit row.
S2: 400 with INVALID_RUN_ID, INVALID_FLOW, INVALID_STEP or INVALID_END as listed; no onboard.step or onboard.exit row.
S3: one runId; steps 1, 2, 3 then end escape at step 3.
S4: tour-start tells createsite then createsite:skip, never template; tour-site ends as skip at the step shown.
S5: equal lists; ends close/escape/cta for welcome and done/skip/escape/gone for the tours.
evidence: Asked 26/10/2026 after the Welcome popup (#1731) and the tour (#1629) shipped: only 'closed at' was kept, so a finished tour and a skipped one read the same
fence: Usage never stands in the person's way: nothing waits on it; only listed flows, steps and ends are kept; one end per showing

cmd: --test-name-pattern=onboarding/step|tells|every scene and tour step|a step and an end
tests: POST /api/onboarding/step keeps one step per showing and step
POST /api/onboarding/step refuses what is not on the closed lists
the Welcome popup tells each scene it reached
Skip on the first-run tour tells the step it was at
the site tour tells each step it reached
every scene and tour step the guides can name is on the server
